structure.unit: Taxes Administered by the Department of Taxation

law.catch_line: Sealed pack labeled as cigarettes; prima facie evidence of cigarettes
law.text: In any prosecution for violations of this title, where a sealed pack is labeled as containing cigarettes, such labeling shall be prima facie evidence that the contents of the pack meet the definition of "cigarette" as defined by § 58.1-1000. Nothing shall preclude the introduction of other relevant evidence to establish the contents of a pack, whether sealed or not.
